subject: Compliance add-on pricing & credit structure for HealthBridge (audit logs, KMS, residency)
messages:
From: Jane Wilson <j.wilson@healthbridge.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-16T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Inquiry: pricing breakdown for compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency)

Diego —

Thanks for taking our call earlier. Procurement has asked for a written breakdown of the add-on costs so we can include them in the RFP pack. Specifically we need:

- Line-item pricing for Audit Logs (per GB ingested / retained) and an example of retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days).
- KMS / HSM options: monthly management fee + per-tenant key rotation costs if applicable.
- Data residency: cost delta for hosting in a US-only region vs multi-region.
- HIPAA add-on: one-time attestation / onboarding fee + monthly surcharge if any.

We also want to understand if Redwood offers any one-time onboarding credits for large customers (we're evaluating committed spend of ~1.2M USD ARR). Attached is our current RFP excerpt (procurement_RFP.pdf) — highlights on page 3.

Can you send a draft quote and let me know when you have time for a final scoping call?

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Wilson
Sr. Procurement Manager, HealthBridge

Attachments: procurement_RFP.pdf

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Wilson <j.wilson@healthbridge.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-16T13:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: pricing breakdown for compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency)

Hi Jane —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is an initial proposal and per-feature pricing summary so your procurement team can plug numbers into the RFP. High-level notes:

- Audit logs: Tiered retention pricing (USD per GB/month): 30d = $0.04/GB, 90d = $0.03/GB, 365d = $0.018/GB. We include compressed ingestion; sample export CSV attached.
- KMS/HSM: Two options — Managed KMS (our key management backed by cloud KMS) = $1,200/month per tenant + $0.005 per key rotation operation; Dedicated HSM (FIPS-140-2 hardware-backed) = $6,500/month + one-time provisioning $12,000.
- Data residency: US-only region premium = +6% on hosted API invoice (covers zone reservation & audit controls).
- HIPAA add-on: One-time attestation/onboarding: $10,000; monthly HIPAA surcharge: +3% on token-based usage charges for additional controls and audit retention.

Onboarding credit: for a committed ARR of $1M+, we usually consider a one-time onboarding credit between 5–12% depending on term and whether they purchase Dedicated capacity. For your stated ~1.2M ARR, I put an initial suggestion of a 10% onboarding credit that we can discuss.

Attached: HealthBridge_SOW_SLA_proposal_v3.pdf, Audit-logs-sample.csv

When are you and legal free for a 30–45 minute call? I have availability Thu (7/17) 10–12 ET or Fri (7/18) 14–16 ET.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales Lead — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0146

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-17T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: HealthBridge pricing — asking for onboarding credit and KMS/HSM guidance

Grace / Rafael —

Forwarding the thread with HealthBridge. They're a likely mid-enterprise deal (~1.2M ARR). Jane asked explicitly about a one-time onboarding credit and we proposed 10% in my draft. Procurement has strong leverage on residency and HSM pricing.

Quick ask: can we approve a one-time credit of up to 10% (applied against first-year committed spend) conditional on a 12-month minimum residency commitment? If finance needs guardrails, I'm proposing:

- 10% credit if they sign 12-month minimum residency + 12-month committed ARR >= $1M;
- 5% credit if they pick multi-region or < $1M but >= $750k;
- No credit for month-to-month or non-committed hosted usage.

Additional question: any flexibility to pass through actual HSM provisioning costs as billable one-time fees instead of amortizing? That helps keep recurring surcharge lower. Rafael — tagging you for finance / legal constraints and any suggested language for SOW.

Thanks,
Diego

On Thu, Jul 16, 2026 at 1:05 PM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see below)

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T09:47:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HealthBridge pricing — asking for onboarding credit and KMS/HSM guidance

Diego —

Thanks for the context. I'm comfortable with the 10% onboarding credit as long as it's explicitly conditioned on: 

- Signed 12-month commitment for the US-residency add-on (we need the commitment to avoid overprovisioning);
- A non-cancellable minimum committed ARR figure (we should use $1M to match your ask);
- Credit applied against first invoice after Go-Live (not refundable).

On HSM provisioning: agree with Rafael that we should surface the one-time provisioning as a separate billable line item ("HSM provisioning fee") in the SOW and avoid amortizing it into the monthly recurring unless they request amortization. This keeps our recurring cost predictable.

Also recommend we offer a capped pass-through for key rotation ops if volume exceeds forecast (>1M rotations/month) — propose $0.002/rotation beyond threshold.

If everyone agrees, I can draft SOW language and a short approval note for Finance.

-Grace
Grace O'Connor
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T11:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: HealthBridge pricing — finance input and redline path

Team —

Finance is OK with the conditional credit structure but we need to lock a few items before any legal / SOW sign-off: 

1) Clear definition of "committed ARR" (MRR * 12) and effective start date (first invoice after go-live).
2) HSM provisioning: we will bill the $12k provisioning as a one-time, non-refundable fee; option to amortize over 12 months only if the customer signs a 24-month minimum term.
3) Residency premium: apply a 6% line-item surcharge; however, for customers with Dedicated pools we can negotiate down to 3% if they commit to a minimum throughput (TBD).

I've attached a quick cost-factor spreadsheet that models our margin by scenario. If we want to be competitive, I'd accept giving them 10% onboarding credit but cap total invoice credits to $120k for this deal.

Also: please send the redlined quote through DocuSign when ready (I've included a link below) so we can capture approvals and track counters in HubSpot.

Attachments: KMS_HSM_Factoring.xlsx

-Rafael
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Jane Wilson <j.wilson@healthbridge.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: 2026-07-20T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing & credit structure for HealthBridge (audit logs, KMS, residency)

Diego —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for pulling together the internal approvals. HealthBridge is comfortable moving forward on the following basis:

- 12-month US-residency add-on commitment.
- One-time onboarding credit: 10% applied to first-year committed spend (capped at $120k).
- HSM provisioning billed as a one-time fee ($12k).
- HIPAA attestation fee ($10k) and 3% monthly surcharge agreed.

Please send the final SOW and DocuSign link. We will route to legal and procurement immediately and target sign-off by next Tue (7/27).

I've attached the RFP excerpt again for reference and included Procurement contact.

Best,
Jane Wilson
Sr. Procurement Manager, HealthBridge
